name: ESPRIT (BP)
fullName: Lowering Systolic Blood Pressure to <120 mm Hg versus <140 mm Hg in Patients at High Cardiovascular Risk
population: n=11255, mean 64.6 ± 7.1, NIHSS high cardiovascular risk; 4359 with diabetes and 3022 with previous stroke, median 3.4 years
teachingPoint: An SBP target <120 reduced major vascular events versus <140, with consistent benefit in patients with diabetes and prior stroke.

name: BPROAD
fullName: Intensive Blood-Pressure Control in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes
population: n=12821, >=50 (mean 63.8 ± 7.5); 45.3% women, NIHSS type 2 diabetes with elevated SBP and increased cardiovascular risk, median 4.2 years
finding: Favors intensive: 1.65 vs 2.09 events per 100 person-years
teachingPoint: In type 2 diabetes, an SBP target <120 cut major cardiovascular events by 21% versus <140, at the cost of more hypotension and hyperkalemia.
